Vintage 1977 Franklin Mint "Classic American Locomotives" Sterling Silver Silhouettes  Set of 4 Framed Wall Art


Up for auction is a beautiful, complete four-piece set of the 1977 Franklin Mint Classic American Locomotives collection. Released as a limited edition in August 1977, these intricate historical illustrations are crafted from genuine sterling silver, chemically etched or printed onto a mirror-polished silver plaque. Each silhouette is permanently sealed under a protective clear coating to prevent tarnishing and beautifully displayed against a contrasting golden-tan mat.

Included Pieces & Historical Subjects

The Susquehanna (1854)  Detailed early American steam locomotive illustration.

The Baldwin "Tiger" (1856)  Celebrated mid-19th-century passenger train design.

The Mercury (1842)  Iconic early B&O Railroad engine.

The John Stevens (1849)  Rare historical pioneering design.

• General Coverage: The Judds profile, Walker Spy Clan investigation, Alzheimer's family featureFall 1986Special Anniversary Issue: 50 Years• Rare, oversized commemorative double-issue celebratory piece
